subject: DPA clarifications, SCCs/SOC2 evidence & HIPAA scope — routing plan
messages:
From: Elena Kovacs <elena.kovacs@fintechsolutions.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@fintechsolutions.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Initial DPA & SOC2/SCCs questions for Redwood

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — excited about the performance numbers. Procurement here; we're starting the legal/security intake for the purchase order. A few asks to unblock legal: 

- Can you confirm SOC 2 Type II scope and latest report availability (redacted ok)?
- We need an SCCs mapping showing cross-border transfers (we operate in EU + US).
- Is HIPAA/BAA coverage available for the product if we process PHI for pilots?
- Our legal team will propose DPA redlines; are you ok with DocuSign for signature routing?

I've attached our vendor questionnaire to give context. Ideally we close DPA redlines and evidence within two weeks.

Thanks,
Elena Kovacs
Senior Procurement Manager
FinTech Solutions

Attachment: FinTechVendorQuestionnaire_20260819.pdf

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Elena Kovacs <elena.kovacs@fintechsolutions.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial DPA & SOC2/SCCs questions for Redwood

Hi Elena — appreciate the clear list. Looping in Marissa from Legal and Karthik (AM) to coordinate. High-level plan below: 

1) I attached our current DPA redline (Redwood_DPA_v1.5_redline.pdf) with the baseline we'd prefer.
2) Marissa will review any counter-redlines and list non-starters.
3) We'll provide SOC2 summary + a redacted report link and an SCCs mapping sheet by end of day Monday 24-Aug.
4) On HIPAA: we can support a BAA for entity-level customers and controlled deployments — Marissa, can you add the scope note?

Proposed docu/sign steps: Redwood legal signs first, then Elena/FinTech procurement via DocuSign. If you need exec sign-off, we can route after countersign.

Next steps: Elena — let us know any initial DPA specific clauses you know you'll push on (e.g., CS retention, subprocessor list, indemnity).

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_DPA_v1.5_redline.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, Elena Kovacs <elena.kovacs@fintechsolutions.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 08:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial DPA & SOC2/SCCs questions for Redwood

Hi all — quick summary from Legal after an initial pass on the redline attached to Vanessa's note: 

- Retention & deletion: Redwood accepts a 30/90/365 retention ladder depending on data class; we'll propose specific language and an evidence checklist.
- Indemnity: standard mutual indemnities; we'll not accept open-ended consequential damage exposure — proposed compromise in the attached notes.
- SCCs: we will provide a mapping document showing transfer mechanisms; note that for EU customers we prefer SCCs + DPA rather than SCC-only.
- HIPAA/BAA: Redwood has an optional BAA addendum for customers processing PHI on dedicated/private deployments. For hosted we can support controls but require Limited Data Processing Addendum — we'll flag non-standard requirements.

I've attached a short "DPA_Redline_Notes_20260820.docx" summarizing what Legal can accept vs items needing escalation. Priyom — can you gather the SOC2 evidence bundle and SCCs mapping (SOC2 summary + redacted report + mapping spreadsheet) by Monday so we can push to procurement?

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security | Redwood Inference

Attachment: DPA_Redline_Notes_20260820.docx

From: Elena Kovacs <elena.kovacs@fintechsolutions.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@fintechsolutions.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 08:49:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial DPA & SOC2/SCCs questions for Redwood

Thanks Marissa — useful summary. A couple quick follow-ups: 

- HIPAA: we are running a small pilot that will process limited PHI; our InfoSec wants clarity whether hosted (shared) falls inside your BAA boundary or if we must use a dedicated deployment. A short note from Legal that explains the difference would be helpful.
- SOC2: redacted report is fine — procurement will route to InfoSec.
- Is there a standard escalation path if a customer needs SOC2 evidence faster (e.g., for bank/regulatory review)?

We're aiming to finalize DPA redlines by Friday 28-Aug to meet procurement timelines.

Elena

Attachment: FinTechVendorQuestionnaire_20260819.pdf

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Elena Kovacs <elena.kovacs@fintechsolutions.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial DPA & SOC2/SCCs questions for Redwood — Evidence & Signing plan

Elena — good questions. Quick answers and action items: 

- HIPAA/BAA: Marissa attached the short scope note below; hosted shared tier does not automatically qualify for a full BAA unless configured and contractually scoped. For your pilot we can provision a limited-data configuration (logging ACLs + retention controls) but recommend dedicated/private for full BAA coverage. Marissa, if we can drop a one-paragraph summary for procurement that would be great.

- SOC2 & SCCs: Priyom has uploaded the artifacts. Links and attached files: SOC2_Type2_summary_2026.pdf and SCCs-mapping-sheet.xlsx. The redacted Type II report is available on our secure drive link I included.

- Escalation: if InfoSec needs expedited attestation we can fast-track a redacted report request (48-72h SLA) if procurement flags it as regulatory; otherwise standard timeline is 5 business days.

Signing workflow: Redwood signs DPA internally within 24h of agreement; we will send via DocuSign (link below) for FinTech Solutions signature. If you require countersignature from an exec after procurement, add a note in DocuSign and we'll route accordingly.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/invitation/details/ABC123-FTS-2026
Drive (redacted SOC2): https://drive.redwood.com/shared/fts/dpa-redlines-20260820

Proposed timeline: finalize redlines by Fri 28-Aug; internal sign by Mon 31-Aug; DocuSign completion target Wed 02-Sep. Let me know if that meets your timelines.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_Type2_summary_2026.pdf; SCCs-mapping-sheet.xlsx
